name: native-markdown-mathjax
description: MathJax support for VS Code's native Markdown preview

nativeMarkdownMathJax.preambleFile.description: Path to a TeX macro preamble file. Relative paths are resolved against the Markdown document's workspace folder; if the document is not in a workspace, they are resolved against the Markdown file's own directory. Supports ${workspaceFolder} and ${documentDir}. The file should contain raw TeX definitions without $$ delimiters.
